name: dev-agent-skills
tagline_zh: 把 Git 和 GitHub 的繁琐操作变成一句话指令，还能自己写新技能。内置 20 多个实战模板，开箱即用。
tagline_en: Turn Git & GitHub chores into one-line commands, plus author your own skills. 20+ ready-to-use templates inside.
desc_en: Claude Code skills plugin for Git, GitHub, and skill authoring workflows
why_zh: 不只是命令集合，它教你如何构建新技能，形成可复用的工作流，这是同类插件少有的。
why_en: Not just a command pack—it teaches you to build new skills, enabling reusable workflows that others lack.
